note: Policy data. Deterministic input to the triage engine. Every rule carries its citation. Adding a depot or changing a cap is an edit here, never a code change. NOTE: since engine consolidation this file no longer produces farmer-facing verdicts - the FastAPI service in backend/ does. It is kept as the tested reference implementation of the same statutory math. See docs/design/integration.md.

national_id.label: Original National ID
national_id.detail: The original card. A photocopy is refused at the counter.

evoucher_code.label: E-Voucher SMS code
evoucher_code.detail: The registration SMS from 40022. Bring the phone the SMS was sent to.

land_title.label: Title deed
land_title.detail: For land you own. If you lease, bring the lease agreement instead.

lease_agreement.label: Chief's stamped lease agreement
lease_agreement.detail: For leased land. Must bear the Area Chief's official stamp - an unstamped lease is refused.

chief_letter.label: Chief's letter, stamped
chief_letter.detail: Confirms you farm in the location. Must bear the chief's official stamp, not only a signature.

coop_membership.label: Cooperative membership card
coop_membership.detail: Required where the depot allocates through a registered cooperative.

wao_form.label: Duly signed Ward Agricultural Officer (WAO) form
wao_form.detail: The scheme form countersigned by the Ward Agricultural Officer for your ward. A blank or unsigned form is refused.

proof_of_land.label: Proof of land
proof_of_land.detail: Any one of these satisfies the land requirement.

paymentAtDepot.headline: Zero cash accepted at the depot
paymentAtDepot.notice: Cash is NOT accepted at any NCPB depot counter. Pay to the NCPB till number displayed at the depot, or deposit at the bank the depot manager names, and carry the receipt.
